translations.web: They have all turned away. They have together become unprofitable. There is no one who does good, no, not so much as one.”
translations.bsb: All have turned away, they have together become worthless; there is no one who does good, not even one.”
translations.kjv: They are all gone out of the way, they are together become unprofitable; there is none that doeth good, no, not one.
translations.asv: They have all turned aside, they are together become unprofitable; There is none that doeth good, no, not, so much as one:
